title: Production AI Quality and Releases
outcome: Release a versioned behaviour change only with evidence and controlled exposure.

steps.input: Immutable prompt/retriever/index/model/policy/dataset/evaluator/gate identities.
steps.output: A reproducible evaluated bundle and expected case set are recorded.
steps.failure: Mutable aliases or mismatched dataset/report bindings cannot establish approval.

steps.input: All eight structured precomputed outputs and versioned rubric.
steps.output: Case and slice scores are computed with valid finite metric labels.
steps.failure: Missing, duplicate or malformed coverage fails closed rather than flattering the mean.

steps.input: Quality score, known safety count, fixture p95 and mean cost.
steps.output: The good fixture passes only the teaching gate for further controlled validation.
steps.failure: Known access violations block independently of an aggregate threshold.

steps.input: Approved exact bundle hash and eligible tenant/user units.
steps.output: Sticky eligible canary assignment preserves the stable control route.
steps.failure: Unapproved bundles, tenants or weakened report gates cannot become a candidate.

steps.input: Bounded bundle/cohort outcome, timing and numeric usage metadata.
steps.output: Redacted diagnostic evidence supports comparison.
steps.failure: Raw prompts, bearer tokens and source bodies do not belong in ordinary events.

steps.input: Current expected generation and sufficient observed evidence.
steps.output: A fresh command can promote or withdraw a candidate.
steps.failure: Stale commands fail; a fixture pass alone is not production approval.

steps.input: Saved result identity and original bundle provenance.

steps.failure: Never erase a result or retry an uncertain provider action to match a new route.

diagrams.title: Before: recoverable runtime without quality release gates
diagrams.description: Existing current-policy runtime, saved results and diagnostic signals remain. Successful HTTP/latency does not prove the supplier answer is correct.

diagrams.title: After: evidence-bound staged release
diagrams.description: Immutable bundle/dataset/evaluator/gate identities drive slice-aware checks and approved routing. Runtime security, budgets and result identity remain independent.
nodes: Sticky eligible canary or safe shadow

diagrams.title: Release lifecycle
diagrams.description: Freeze, run, gate, assign, observe, decide and preserve. Known safety failures block; routing rollback does not erase saved outcomes.

lab_title: Which release gate blocks the candidate?
lab_assumptions: Eight authored cases and synthetic output/latency/cost labels. No model call or production approval. Changing worksheet thresholds does not change approved teaching-gate-v1; known safety cannot be disabled.
style_notes: /* Hallmark · dismissed 46a · all quality percentages are computed over eight explicitly authored fixture cases; latency/cost values and gate thresholds are labelled teaching inputs, not measured customer performance */
